meta: Ask AI to review your spending and find where your money leaks, just from a list of what you spent. Day 5 of the 7-day AI challenge.

muc.title: Day 5: reviewing your spending
muc.text: Day five of seven: money keeps disappearing and you don't know where. AI can find the leaks from a simple spending list.

muc.title: Remove account numbers first
muc.text: Copy your expenses: date, item and amount. Delete account numbers, card numbers and recipient names before pasting.

muc.title: Group and total
muc.text: Ask AI to group them into food, transport and shopping, then total each group.

muc.title: Find two leaks
muc.text: Ask AI to point out the two small expenses that repeat the most. AI helps you see clearly; it doesn't give investment advice.

muc.title: Day 5 task
muc.text: Paste the last seven days of spending into a chatbot, ask it to group and total them, then pick one thing to cut.
